title: Staffage Catalog Silhouette Guard Passes For Every Asset
description: Make the staffage library guard catalog-silhouette pass for every catalog asset by fixing authored drawings, volumes or declared dimensions per mismatch, never loosening the guard.
summary: catalog-silhouette now passes for all 152 staffage assets (guard unchanged). Final run: validate-all 0 failing of 152, validate-manifest 0 issues, vitest catalog-silhouette, schema-conformance, asset-power, three-views, fill-rule, plan-projection, section-views 7 files / 608 tests passed, React suite 29 files / 276 tests passed. Work was split by category across subagents; per mismatch the drawing, volume or declared dimension was corrected (tracing drawings from the volume projection, matching members/strokes, fixing declared dimensions, one-cell slits, end-on bar dots). Follow-ups fixed three-views spread failures (pigeon, person-cooking, city-bicycle, horse, jogger), a malformed tour-guide shape, tealight 1:200 sharp-vs-owned raster disagreement and the sectional-garage-door coil (285 MB SVG). Declared dimensions corrected for several assets and 11 manifest entries synced. Notes: silhouette-*.md files in the ticket folder. Caveat: several drawings now hold traced polygons (large files for dairy-cow, horse, scots-pine, english-oak); some results sit at the limit (e.g. tower-crane 1:100 front 0.0300 vs 0.03, rollator 1:50 plan 15.0 mm).
